notes:
# eXiled's Gateway 0.1.2

- NPCs talk: Talk shows their dialogue for your quest progress (text; voice comes later).
- Stamina works: running drains it, walking refills it, you walk when it runs out.
- Dual wield: Barbarians hold a weapon in each hand, Assassins two claws; Frenzy, Double Swing, Double Throw and
  Dragon Claw work.
- New screens in the D2R style: character sheet with Advanced Stats, skill tree tab names, party panel, character
  select, vendor window, stash Runes/Gems/Materials slots, and a form to set up an online realm.
- Chat opens with Enter; the area name shows when you enter a level; the automap follows the walls.
- HD: neighbouring levels are drawn across level edges (no black half-screen), fewer ground streaks, monsters walk
  instead of sliding, flames sit on their torches and braziers, smoother level changes.
- Monsters stay out of towns; you respawn in the town of your current act with full life and can't move while dead.
- Shrines show their type; the monster bar matches D2R; level names are right ("Blood Moor").
- The launcher ignores the old "dev tools" setting in release builds.
